why: Xinyao Zhang's arXiv paper (Nov 2024, revised through Jul 2025) proves the remaining open p=3 case of the two-dimensional regular Fontaine-Mazur conjecture over Q, completing the regular case for all odd primes; separately Jack Thorne (Aug 2026) proves new GL(2) cases.
